description:
Recto: Accounts in Hebrew. Dating: probably ca. 16th century. The main currency is ducats (peraḥim); also mentions the grosso (גרושו). Mentioning various types of garments. There are some terms from a Romance language (likely Ladino, e.g. קושאקי or מאנטאש). Several names are mentioned, e.g. Ḥayyim al-Dayyan, Yehuda Zohar, Yosef. Several debts "to the Yeshiva" are mentioned. Large and fairly well preserved, merits further examination. 

Verso is a book list.
description_he: רשימת חובות מאוחרת בצד הרקטו. רשימת ספרים בצד הורסו.
